what: float64 time-dependent fourth-order operators of deep tanh MLPs u(t, x) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 (t, x) + b_1) ...) + bo, W_1 of shape (H, 1 + D), at B points (t ~ U(0, 1), x ~ N(0, I / D)): forward = operator values; vg = 0.5 mean (Op u - f)^2 and its gradient w.r.t. every weight, bias and readout parameter. Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_bilaplacian.projected_deep_bilaplacian with coordinates = the D space indices, a diagonal diffusion s for hyperadv, the squared space gradient and the time or advection direction as a carried first-order direction: the (scaled) space columns of W_1 are projected to k = min(D, H) columns. Cells with D <= H are controls where the projection cannot reduce anything. Taylor mode runs where D <= 2048, omnibias.jax.laplacian with a nested Hessian where D <= 256, nested autodiff where D <= 64 and the previous exact path (deep_field_polylaplacian support mode) where D <= 8; the projected-generic tier feeds the same projected columns to generic engines (D > H cells only), isolating the closed-form recursion from the projection
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's forward and vg programs on a reduced instance (width 4, B = 2, D_q = min(D, 12) space coordinates so the projection is active when D > 4, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (fourth-order Taylor series over (t, x) along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions of the scaled space columns and first order along the carried direction, no projection or selection; objective derivatives along two fixed random parameter directions by central differences in 50 digits): values and objective 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivatives 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.forward_bilaplacian_full_seed: the same recursion seeded with all D space columns W_1[:, 1:] (scaled by s): per unit gradient, Hessian, Laplacian, gradient of the Laplacian, bi-Laplacian and the v tangent; isolates the projection
tiers.nested_forward_laplacian: folx.forward_laplacian of folx.forward_laplacian of y -> u(t, x + s y), or y -> u(t, y); value and gradient from the inner forward Laplacian
tiers.taylor_mode: fourth-order Taylor mode along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions of the scaled space columns, started at the first pre-activation: jax.experimental.jet, and collapsed Taylor mode propagating only the weighted order-4 sum; gradient from the first-order coefficients; k <= 2048
tiers.nested_autodiff: jax.hessian trace of omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian at the first pre-activation z_1 + C y, k <= 256; jax.hessian trace of the jax.hessian trace, k <= 64
tiers.projected_generic_engines: folx2 and collapsed Taylor mode given the candidate's first-layer projection, g(y) = u at z_1 + F y, k = H; only cells with D > H; isolates the recursion from the projection

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
